summary: Enhance your project management expertise with our Advanced Negotiation Skills Course. Master techniques to negotiate effectively and achieve project success.
lede: Advanced negotiation training gives project managers a structured way to prepare for delivery discussions and secure documented agreements. Participants practise clarifying interests, setting BATNA and ZOPA, assessing stakeholder influence, and using cost and schedule evidence to negotiate scope, schedule, resource and supplier trade-offs; they also document commitments and track actions through project controls.
audienceIntro: This project negotiation course is designed for professionals who must secure commitments, resolve delivery friction, and document decisions across project environments. It suits you if you negotiate regularly but want a more consistent method, as well as professionals moving into project leadership who need a practical foundation before handling complex discussions.
prerequisites: You need practical exposure to project work, including scope, schedule, risk, stakeholder, or supplier coordination. No legal qualification, procurement certification, or programming experience is required. You should bring a current or representative project negotiation scenario for application during exercises, with confidential details removed.
